## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #09 BLUEPRINT
### Auto-Reply to Customer Inquiry Emails & Log Leads in Google Sheets

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep09&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Inquiry_Time | Lead_Name | Lead_Email | Estimated_Budget | Auto_Reply_Status`
* [Open Episode #09 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep09/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rb0K08SASCU)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Watches Gmail 24/7 for incoming client quote/pricing/inquiry emails and filters out automated newsletters.
* **Zone 2:** Extracts Lead Name, Email, and Project Budget from the email and drafts a personalized response.
* **Zone 3:** Sends a **real Gmail reply** (`n8n-nodes-base.gmail`) in under 1 second and logs the lead to your **Google Sheets CRM**.

## STEP 1: Watch Customer Inquiry Emails 24/7
1. Double-click **1. Watch Incoming Customer Inquiries (Gmail)** -> connect your Google account.
2. **2. Is Real Customer Inquiry?** prevents auto-replying to `noreply@` or automated receipts.

## STEP 2: Extract Lead Details & Draft Reply
1. **3. Parse Lead Name, Budget & Personalized Reply** extracts the sender's first name, company, and budget mention (`$4,500`) to personalize the reply.

## STEP 3: Send Real Gmail Reply & Log to CRM Sheet
1. **4. Send Instant Personalized Reply (Gmail)** sends the real response email to the lead.
2. **5. Log Lead to Google Sheets CRM** records the lead in your spreadsheet 24/7 on [Hostinger KVM 1](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep09&src=json_step3)!
